name: React Fancy Switch
summary: Animated, accessible switch and segmented control component for React, shipped as @omit/react-fancy-switch.
description: A customizable React component for switching between multiple options: it behaves like a radio group and animates a highlighter between the options without framer-motion. It accepts primitive (string/number/boolean) or object options, works controlled (value + onChange) or uncontrolled, and allows custom container, option and highlighter styling plus custom option rendering. Accessibility covers radiogroup/radio roles, roving tabindex, keyboard navigation and a live region. Published on npm as @omit/react-fancy-switch.
contains: one component: animated switch / segmented control
primitive or object options, controlled or uncontrolled
accessibility: radiogroup roles, roving tabindex, live region
